tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the jobs that match the user's résumé and filters, best match first, a page at a time. Leaves out jobs already applied to unless include_applied is true, and postings open only to nationals unless the profile lists a nationality or nationals_only says otherwise. Reads only.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The full posting, the match assessment against the user, and any application status. Reads only.

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Up to 20 postings by id with their match assessments, descriptions shortened; ids not found come back in missing. Reads only.

tools.name: get_job_from_link
tools.description: Reads the posting at an employer or job-board link, keeps it in the user's saved jobs and returns it with its match assessment and job id. Fetches the employer's page; applies to nothing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the jobs matching the user's résumé, best match first, as citable results with the employer's posting URL; fetch returns a result's full text. Reads only.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one job from search, with its posting URL and match details. Reads only.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: The user's applications, newest first, with status and the employer's receipt when sent. status needs_you keeps those waiting on the user, uncertain those sent without a confirmed receipt (never sent again); started_by_this_client keeps those this assistant started. Reads only.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: One application: status and step (blocked with its reason and retry_at while Applysent waits to retry), receipt, the answers sent, any open questions, suggested_next_tool and poll_after_seconds. Reads only.

tools.name: get_application_receipt
tools.description: The employer's confirmation evidence for one application: the receipt, the answers sent, the proof files and the confirmation screenshot as an image when one was captured. Reads only.

tools.name: list_pending_questions
tools.description: Questions employers asked that only the user can answer; the applications asking them wait. Each is asked once and its answer is reused for every application asking it. Reads only.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The user's plan, applications left this week and today (or unlimited), and anything stopping applications from being sent. Reads only.

tools.name: get_profile_status
tools.description: What the user's Applysent profile still needs before applications can go out, and how many employer questions wait. Reports what is missing, not the values. Reads only.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: Employer emails in the user's application inbox, newest first, classified (interview, rejection, verification, assessment...) and linked to the application they belong to. Reads only; nothing is sent.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: One email from the application inbox with its text and the application it belongs to. Reads only.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Every email of the same application as the given one, or of the same sender and subject when it belongs to none, oldest first, without bodies. Reads only.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Saves the given answer to one open question and applies it to every application asking it; those applications then continue. The answer is stored exactly as given, as the user's own words or the option they chose.

tools.name: preview_tailored_resume
tools.description: The résumé tailored to one job, as the PDF an application would attach, with what changed against the saved résumé. Made once with an AI model from facts already in the résumé, then reused; nothing is sent.

tools.name: approve_tailored_resume
tools.description: Marks the previewed tailored résumé (by its resume_sha256) as the one to send with this job's application. Sends nothing.

tools.name: regenerate_tailored_resume
tools.description: Discards the job's tailored résumé and its approval and tailors it again with an AI model from the saved résumé. Refused once the application was sent.

tools.name: preview_application
tools.description: What applying to one job would send and use, and a single-use confirmation_token for apply_to_job. The token works for this job and this connection only and expires after 10 minutes. Sends nothing.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Sends a real application to one job on the employer's site and uses one application from the user's plan. Requires the confirmation_token preview_application returned for this job. A job already applied to, or sent with an uncertain outcome, is never sent again. A posting held on an employer account

tools.name: cancel_application
tools.description: Stops an application whose send has not started; it can then never be sent and its open questions are withdrawn. Refused once sending started.

tools.name: get_autopilot
tools.description: Whether Autopilot applies to matching jobs by itself, its filters, limits and today's sends. Reads only.

tools.name: preview_autopilot
tools.description: A dry run: the jobs Autopilot would apply to next under the current filters or proposed ones, with a single-use confirmation_token for turning it on or for exactly those filters. Sends nothing and changes nothing.

tools.name: set_autopilot
tools.description: Turning it on lets Applysent apply to matching jobs by itself, using plan applications; it requires the confirmation_token preview_autopilot returned. Turning it off needs no token.

tools.name: update_autopilot_filters
tools.description: Saves new job titles, countries, workplace, salary floor, exclusions, match threshold or daily limit for Autopilot and job matching. Requires the confirmation_token preview_autopilot returned for exactly these filters.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_inbox, get_message, get_thread · Private data: get_application_receipt, preview_application, set_autopilot · Public sink: get_message, get_thread, approve_tailored_resume, preview_application, cancel_application · Destructive: preview_autopilot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_inbox, get_message, get_thread · Private data: get_application_receipt, preview_application, set_autopilot · Public sink: get_message, get_thread, approve_tailored_resume, preview_application, cancel_application · Destructive: preview_autopilot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
